title: CreateAnniversaryRequest
description: Complete Anniversary create plan. timezone is the explicit IANA timezone used for countdown and Reminder materialization. date remains the only yearly anchor. recurrence=null creates a one-time Anniversary. reminder_plan is an additive legacy bridge: omission means reminders disabled with an empty template set; an object is the complete initial plan; explicit null is invalid. lunar reaches C++ so it can return ANNIVERSARY_CALENDAR_UNSUPPORTED.

date.description: Original user-local date. For yearly recurrence its month/day are the occurrence anchor and its year remains the historical origin year.

recurrence.description: Yearly Anniversary recurrence intent, or null for a one-time Anniversary.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used by C++ to derive the local date and calculate the response countdown.

reminder_plan.description: Optional only for legacy v2 callers. Missing means {reminders_enabled:false, templates:[]}; null is never accepted. New writers must always send this field.
